body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Zoozmobile presented its gesture-based mobile musical software 'Zoozbeat' during CES 2009, which is simple enough for non-musicians to immediately become musically expressive.

Users can start playing with just a click or select among background beats in a variety of styles, and then use shake and tilt movements, tap the screen, or press the keypads to create and modify rhythmic and melodic lines.
The Zoozbeat supports up to 4 background beats, 20 instrument sounds and voice recording function and more.
< AVING Special Report Team for 'CES 2009' : Idea Kim, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Paul Shin, Miso Kim, Esther Yoon, Abraham Shim, Grace Won, Risa Koo, JB Shim, Jini Shim >
